summary:
Lane 39 (identity management) on shop.lab.test. Only http://shop.lab.test:80 answers; https was refused by the gateway. No test accounts were provided and writes are disallowed, so no registration, login or provisioning was submitted.

Done:
- WSTG-IDNT-01 (role definitions): roles visible without auth are customer (hidden role field on /register) and an admin area at /admin/ (401). No role-listing endpoint was found; /api/v1/roles and /api/v1/users are catch-all stubs.
- WSTG-IDNT-04 (enumeration): forgot-password gives a differential response. 'alice' returned 200 with a masked email, while admin, test, bob and a random name returned 404 "No account uses that username." Recorded as a medium lead. The username-available endpoint returned available:true for every name, so it gives no signal. Side effect: the GET for alice triggered a reset email for that account; the reviewer should note this.

Left open (need writes or authenticated sessions, which this engagement does not allow):
- WSTG-IDNT-02 (registration): the form and the hidden role field were read, but submission and verification need a POST.
- WSTG-IDNT-03 (provisioning): admin and /api/v1/me require authentication; provisioning flows need an admin session and writes.
- WSTG-IDNT-05 (username policy): the availability endpoint accepts any format, but registration enforcement needs a POST.

Leads recorded: the forgot-password enumeration differential, and the hidden role=customer field on /register as a mass-assignment candidate for a write-approved test on a test account.
